site.headline: Everything I have built on GitHub since my first commit.
site.intro: The first repo was a hello world on 14 February 2025. Then nothing for eight months. Since May 2026 it has been most weeks: products, client sites, tools for my own desk, research, and a few forks I learned from. Each entry says what it is and whether it is live.
site.closer: Want one of these built for you? Start at c4e.in.

projects.name: sg-posture
projects.title: SG Posture
projects.blurb: A macOS menu-bar app that reads head motion from AirPods Pro, 3, 4 and Max. Calibrate once. It plays a sound when you slouch for 8 seconds.

projects.name: india-vc-exit-performance
projects.title: India VC Exit Performance
projects.blurb: A dashboard of 16 Indian VC funds. It shows who returned cash to LPs and who still holds paper marks, from IPO filings, Bain-IVCA reports and SEBI disclosures.
